data.name: Rizwana
data.gender_notes: Rizwana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rizwana is a name that symbolizes kindness, compassion, and generosity. It is inspired by the Arabic word 'rizwan' which means 'one who is favored by God'. The name Rizwana carries the meaning “Blessed with kindness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rizwana usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is blessed with kindness and compassion, bringing peace and harmony to those around them.
data.etymology: Rizwana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with kindness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rizwana total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
